# netbox_rack_reservation (Resource)

A reservation of rack units (dcim.rackreservation).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/rackreservation/):

> Users can reserve specific units within a rack for future use. An arbitrary set of units within a rack can be associated with a single reservation, but reservations cannot span multiple racks. A description is required for each reservation, reservations may optionally be associated with a specific tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_rack" "test" {
  name    = "test-rack"
  site_id = netbox_site.test.id
}

resource "netbox_user" "test" {
  username = "test-user"
  password = "test-password"
}

resource "netbox_tenant" "test" {
  name = "test-tenant"
}

resource "netbox_rack_reservation" "test" {
  rack_id     = netbox_rack.test.id
  units       = [1, 2, 3]
  user_id     = netbox_user.test.id
  tenant_id   = netbox_tenant.test.id
  description = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Purpose of the reservation.
- `rack_id` (Number) Id of the rack.
- `units` (Set of Number) Rack unit numbers being reserved.
- `user_id` (Number) Id of the NetBox user holding the reservation.

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Status of the reservation. One of: pending, active, stale.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `unit_count` (Number) Number of rack units reserved.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_rack_reservation.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_rack_reservation.test 123
```
